stemMd: Which finding would most strengthen the officials' proposed energy-saving inference?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The coating was available in several colours.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The treated roofs were easy to photograph.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Across matched occupied buildings, treatment consistently reduced weather-adjusted cooling electricity use.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Warehouse roof temperatures fell even without air-conditioning.

explanationMd: The missing link is between treatment and energy use. A controlled comparison of weather-adjusted cooling electricity supplies direct support for that link rather than another observation about surface temperature.

distractorRationale.a: Colour availability does not establish energy savings.
distractorRationale.e: This repeats the intermediate measure without energy evidence.
distractorRationale.b: Photographic convenience is irrelevant to the target outcome.
distractorRationale.d: Recognition does not measure electricity consumption.
